governance.authority: Atlas ROS v6.2 governed planning archetype registry

archetypes.title: Controlled technology pilot
archetypes.description: Launch a bounded technical pilot with explicit scope, ownership, controls, evidence, and rollback readiness.
current_checkpoint_templates: Define and approve pilot scope and success measures
Assign the technical owner and confirm low-risk pilot targets
Approve pre-checks, change controls, evidence requirements, and rollback plan
archetypes.delegated_template: Build and execute the technical pilot
archetypes.conditional_template: Review pilot evidence and record the go/no-go decision
archetypes.future_template: Expand beyond the pilot only after an affirmative decision and separately approved rollout scope

archetypes.title: Infrastructure modernization
archetypes.description: Modernize infrastructure through assessment, target design, controlled transition, validation, and retirement of legacy components.
current_checkpoint_templates: Assess the current state and modernization drivers
Approve the target architecture and transition scope
Plan the controlled implementation and validation sequence
archetypes.conditional_template: Review implementation evidence and approve legacy retirement
archetypes.future_template: Optimize the modernized platform after stabilization

archetypes.title: Operational remediation
archetypes.description: Contain and correct an operational weakness with verified cause, corrective controls, validation, and recurrence prevention.
current_checkpoint_templates: Confirm the operational problem and impact
Approve the remediation scope and accountable owner
Validate corrective controls and recurrence-prevention evidence
archetypes.conditional_template: Close the remediation after sustained validation
archetypes.future_template: Expand preventive controls where evidence supports it

archetypes.title: Migration
archetypes.description: Move services, systems, or data to a target state with dependency mapping, cutover controls, validation, and rollback.
current_checkpoint_templates: Confirm migration scope, inventory, and success measures
Approve target-state design, dependencies, and cutover controls
Plan validation, rollback, and post-migration stabilization
archetypes.conditional_template: Approve source retirement after migration evidence is complete
archetypes.future_template: Optimize the target environment after stabilization

archetypes.title: Decommission
archetypes.description: Retire a system safely after dependency clearance, data and service disposition, change approval, and recovery validation.
current_checkpoint_templates: Confirm decommission scope and dependency clearance
Approve data, service, asset, and access disposition
Validate shutdown controls, recovery evidence, and closure criteria
archetypes.conditional_template: Close the record after dependent services and evidence are verified
archetypes.future_template: Remove residual cost and technical debt after closure

archetypes.title: Automation proof of concept
archetypes.description: Validate an automation concept in a bounded environment before authorizing operational use.
current_checkpoint_templates: Define the automation hypothesis and measurable success criteria
Confirm the bounded test environment, owner, and safety controls
Approve evidence, rollback, and operational-adoption criteria
archetypes.delegated_template: Build and run the bounded automation proof of concept
archetypes.conditional_template: Review evidence and decide whether to proceed to a pilot
archetypes.future_template: Operationalize only under separately approved scope

archetypes.title: Compliance readiness
archetypes.description: Prepare for a compliance obligation through scope definition, control mapping, evidence readiness, gap remediation, and review.
current_checkpoint_templates: Confirm the applicable obligation, scope, and accountable owners
Map required controls and evidence to the current state
Approve gap remediation and readiness-review criteria
archetypes.delegated_template: Complete assigned control and evidence remediation
archetypes.conditional_template: Conduct readiness review after evidence is complete
archetypes.future_template: Sustain controls through the approved review cadence

archetypes.title: Vendor evaluation
archetypes.description: Evaluate a vendor against requirements, risk, cost, evidence, and an explicit decision framework.
current_checkpoint_templates: Approve evaluation requirements and decision criteria
Confirm candidate vendors, evidence sources, and stakeholders
Complete comparative risk, cost, capability, and support assessment
archetypes.delegated_template: Collect vendor evidence and conduct assigned evaluations
archetypes.conditional_template: Record the selection decision after comparative evidence is complete
archetypes.future_template: Begin contracting or implementation only after separate approval

archetypes.title: Process improvement
archetypes.description: Improve a recurring process through baseline measurement, target design, controlled adoption, and outcome review.
current_checkpoint_templates: Measure the current process and confirm the improvement outcome
Approve the target process, ownership, and adoption scope
Define implementation, measurement, and sustainment controls
archetypes.conditional_template: Review measured outcomes and decide whether to standardize
archetypes.future_template: Extend the improved process where evidence supports it

archetypes.title: Incident follow-up
archetypes.description: Convert incident evidence into owned corrective actions, risk reduction, validation, and closure.
current_checkpoint_templates: Confirm incident impact, causal evidence, and open risks
Approve corrective actions, owners, and completion evidence
Validate risk reduction and recurrence-prevention controls
archetypes.conditional_template: Close the incident follow-up after evidence is verified
archetypes.future_template: Apply validated preventive patterns to similar services
